name: lean-startup
description: Solo-founder product company: the Lazynext configuration distilled — 13 real agents across marketing, sales, engineering and ops, external dispatch behind approvals.
goals: Grow the accessibility-checker funnel from free scans to paid Pro subscriptions.
Ship product changes through reviewed PRs that keep the test suite green.
Keep every outbound post, campaign and public claim honest and evidence-backed.
Hold infrastructure cost near zero on the Cloudflare free tier.

roles.title: Chief Executive Officer
roles.mission: Set company direction, review priorities and approve cross-team trade-offs.

roles.title: Chief Technology Officer
roles.mission: Break work into safe tasks, review engineering output and guard the protected product files.

roles.title: Marketing Lead
roles.mission: Run growth experiments and draft posts that wait for an approved decision package before dispatch.

roles.title: Sales Lead
roles.mission: Qualify CRM leads and draft outreach campaigns for a human to send, never auto-blast.

roles.title: Customer Success Lead
roles.mission: Answer support tickets and keep customers informed when fixes land.

roles.title: Backend Engineer
roles.mission: Implement worker and API changes with tests on a per-task branch, never on main directly.

roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.mission: Implement dashboard and UI changes without touching protected product files.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.mission: Run the test gate and reject any artifact whose verdict is not a real green run.

roles.title: DevOps Engineer
roles.mission: Handle deploys, Cloudflare resources and CI configuration, gated on explicit approval.

roles.title: Code Reviewer
roles.mission: Review pull requests for defects, secret leaks and scope drift before merge.

roles.title: Knowledge Engineer
roles.mission: Maintain company-brain entries and the vector knowledge index the fleet reads.

roles.title: HR Coordinator
roles.mission: Review agent performance and recommend fleet roster changes.

roles.title: Finance Analyst
roles.mission: Track the outcome ledger, subscription revenue and cost per task.

notes: The shipped Lazynext configuration as of 2026-11: 13 running agents, Dodo billing in test mode, external dispatch gated by the approval decision package, cron every 10 minutes with daily and weekly maintenance sweeps.
